study_id: Raji and Safna - 2022 - Computational methods for predicting the outcome of thoracic transplantation

eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: Although the study uses non‑linear AI models on adult thoracic transplant recipients and is a peer‑reviewed article from 2022, it does not compare the AI predictions to current clinical practice or a gold‑standard comparator.

identification_methods.Sponsorship source: Health Resources and Services Administration contract 234-2005-370011C
identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective study using UNOS data for thoracic transplantation survival prediction with ANN models.
identification_methods.Institution: MEA Engineering College, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India
identification_methods.Address: MEA Engineering College, Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Included adult patients only; pediatric records (9373) removed.
identification_methods.AI Model Architecture: Multi-layer perceptron ANN and Radial Basis Function ANN
identification_methods.Comparator: Existing MLP model from prior study (85.9% accuracy)
identification_methods.Input Variables: 24 selected attributes including GENDER, ABO, TOT_SERUM_ALBUM, RESIST_INF, INIT_AGE, ECMO_TRR, CREAT_TRR, HEMO_PA_MN_TRR, IABP_TRR, ACUTE_REJ_EPI, GTIME, TRTREJ1Y, HLAMIS, PRAMR_CL2, AGE_DON, ABO_DON, GENDER_DON, DOPAMINE_DON_OLD, ABO_MAT, AGE, ISCHITIME, GRF_FAIL_CAUSE, AGE_GROUP, INOTROP_AGENTS
identification_methods.Methods Notes: Feature selection using InfoGain Attribute Eval with ranker; tenfold CV; performance evaluated with accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, ROC AUC.

population.Inclusion criteria: Adult thoracic transplantation patients from UNOS database
population.Population Notes: Dataset originally contained 1,48,509 records; after removing pediatric cases only 485 adult records remained

interventions_outcomes.Intervention Input Data Modality: Tabular clinical variables from UNOS database
interventions_outcomes.Feature Selection Method: InfoGain Attribute Eval with ranker search
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Tenfold cross‑validation, back‑propagation training of ANN models
interventions_outcomes.Reported outcomes in study: Accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision, recall, F‑measure, ROC AUC
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Short‑term survival prediction (1–3 years) after thoracic transplantation
interventions_outcomes.Result data Notes: MLP accuracy 97.1%, RBF accuracy 92.37%; MLP ROC AUC 0.918, RBF ROC AUC 0.95
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: Accuracy on held‑out test set using tenfold cross‑validation
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: MLP outperforms RBF and existing models in accuracy and AUC
